summary: Tested Milestone 1A (Customer Profile) and 1B (User Management) on backend and frontend. Backend: 20/22 tests pass in the new pytest file test_m1_profile_user_mgmt.py. Every requested feature passes: profile sections, rep 403 and hidden financials, customer PATCH plus the 400 for a bad language, follow-up lifecycle, communication permissions with history, consent withdraw (a new record is added and the original is unchanged; a second withdraw gives 400), assign rules (rep 403, other-org or inactive assignee 400), user CRUD and role limits, invite -> set password -> login with status active, deactivate (login 403, existing token 401) and reactivate, and reset tokens being invalidated. The 2 failures are extra security probes I added: (1) a rep can PATCH any lead, including assigned_user_id, which gets around the assign permission; (2) POST /leads/{id}/notes does not check that the lead exists or belongs to the org. Frontend: every requested flow passed. Pipeline card -> profile works and the timeline button still opens the drawer. All 10 tabs render. Assign, stage, follow-up add/done, note (appears in Activities), edit customer, permissions and withdraw all work. On Users: list, search and filters, create -> setup link dialog, edit, reset link, deactivate/reactivate, the reset-password page (mismatch error, bad token error, success) and login of the new user. A manager sees only Sales Representative and no actions on admin rows. A rep has no Users nav item. Regression: appointments, sales, pipeline, leads, dashboard and /sell chat load; the phase1 suite passes 100%.

critical.issue: Not scoped for representatives: a rep can PATCH any lead in the org, including assigned_user_id and status (returns 200). This lets a rep self-assign and get around the POST /assign 403 and the scoped_lead rule. Use scoped_lead and block assigned_user_id for non-managers.

Does not look up the lead at all. Any lead_id, including one that does not exist or belongs to another org, returns 200 and writes an internal_note and an activity. A rep can also add notes to leads not assigned to them. Use scoped_lead.

minor.issue: server.py:317 still treats the customer as consented after a staff-recorded withdrawal, because it looks for any consent_record with status 'accepted' and the original record is kept. Result after a withdrawal: consented=true, can_refer=false. It should check lead.consent_status != 'withdrawn' or the latest record.

The notifications query matches only on recipient_id in [seller email, phone]. It has no organization_id or lead filter, so another customer's or another org's notifications sent to the same email or phone show on this profile. Seen live: an 'Appointment Confirmation' from an earlier customer appeared on a new TEST lead. Add organization_id and preferably a lead_id filter.
Not scoped for reps (no assigned check). It also crashes (500) if the lead has no conversation, because conv is None.
Does not invalidate earlier unused tokens, unlike _issue_reset. It also only prints the token, with no notification stored.
No email format validation, and an empty string is accepted, so it can blank out fields.

ui_bugs.issue: A rep who goes straight to /app/users gets the User Management page with the team list. The API trims the fields, so every row shows 'Last login: Never' and 'Dealership: —', which is misleading. Add a role guard and redirect.

issues: Uses the native datetime-local picker instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover
The assign dropdown lists every active user, including the Dealership Admin, Manager and the Super Admin (platform@). Consider limiting it to reps and managers.

action_items: Scope PATCH /api/leads/{id} with scoped_lead and forbid reps from changing assigned_user_id
Scope POST /api/leads/{id}/notes (and /messages) with scoped_lead so it returns 404 for an unknown or other-org lead and 403 for an unassigned rep
Make the public chat 'consented' check respect a withdrawal (lead.consent_status == 'withdrawn' or the latest consent record)
Add an organization_id filter (and ideally a lead_id filter) to the legacy_notifications query in customer_profile
Add a role guard on the /app/users route for representatives
Update the outdated test tests/test_partners_inventory_referrals.py::test_auto_create_via_run_inventory_match_and_patch: referrals are now consent-gated, so this failure is expected
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1700 lines and should be split further (leads, appointments, sales, inventory routers)

The 'consent_status' values are inconsistent: lead uses 'granted', consent_records uses 'accepted'. Withdraw checks lead.consent_status == 'withdrawn' and the records 'accepted'; this works, but it is easy to break
AssignStage loads its users asynchronously; the select briefly shows only 'Unassigned' (cosmetic)
There is a leftover user newrep_10075@test.com (created by the main agent, not this run) in the Prestige org
